verdict.rationale: Quo's Mintlify-hosted API reference includes a per-endpoint "Try it" playground that runs real requests, and it is backed by published OpenAPI 3.1.0 documents and .md/llms.txt mirrors of every page. The openapi probe 404s only at quo.com paths; the spec is served from S3, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, and a sandbox or test environment (the runner executes against the production API with a real key) so examples can be run safely.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify-hosted API reference runs the "Try it" playground per endpoint, with llms.txt and .md mirrors of every page
